description_en: Adds processes to or removes processes from the whitelist in the application whitelist feature
description_zh: 在应用白名单功能中，将进程加入或取消加入白名单
name: ModifyProcessWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the policy.
You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The MD5 hash of the process startup file.
You can call the [DescribeWhiteListProcess](~~DescribeWhiteListProcess~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
进程启动文件的MD5值。
调用[DescribeWhiteListProcess](~~DescribeWhiteListProcess~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: md5s

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist status of the process. Valid values:
1: Remove from the whitelist.
2: Add to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
设置进程的白名单状态。取值：
1：取消白名单
2：加入白名单
parameters.name: status

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
